## Description

An oval, non-motile yeast cell (~6 × 5 µm) with a chitin-containing wall. It absorbs dissolved
sugars and amino acids, respires with O₂ and ferments without it, and reproduces by budding: the bud
grows at one pole and separates, leaving a bud scar.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `hot_spring` (weight 0.5), `moss` (weight 0.5), `pond` (weight 0.04), `puddle` (weight 0.15), `sea_ice` (weight 0.5), `termite_gut` (weight 0.5); 12 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

Osmotroph (`feeding = "osmotrophy"`) with [budding](../../mechanics/life-cycle-and-division.md). Without
competitors or with lots of organic matter it can take over a drop (see
[drop collapse](../../bugs/drop-bacteria-collapse.md)).
